property_summary: On every admissible input address, calling initialize(addr) on C must revert specifically with Initializable.InvalidInitialization (initializers were disabled in the constructor and the initializer guard fires before __Access_init ever runs); the mutant drops the guard, so the revert instead comes from __Access_init's onlyInitializing check as NotInitializing, changing the revert data.
change_summary: Drop the initializer modifier from initialize so it can be called multiple times, re-running initialization logic on each call.
